#  Frequently Asked Questions
## 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.4884q2crj9vy)
Frequently Asked Questions – Precision Investment Casting
### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.k1nu1b7fthhf)
Q1: What materials can you cast?
We offer a wide range of materials, including:
  * Stainless steel: SUS304, SUS316, SUS410/CA15
  * Carbon steel: S25C, S45C
  * Aluminum alloys: ADC12, AC4C/A356
  * Copper alloys and special tool steels (available upon request)  
  



### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.n7ljf26zbnxi)
Q2: What is your casting process?
We specialize in lost wax investment casting using the silica sol method, which allows for fine surface finishes, tight tolerances, and stable mechanical performance. Vacuum-assisted casting is available for thin-wall and high-precision parts.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.iruhnk1kwnd5)
Q3: What tolerances can you achieve?
Typical dimensional tolerances fall within CT5–CT6 standard, or approximately ±0.05 mm to ±0.1 mm, depending on geometry and size.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.fhj1u9yljvcc)
Q4: What is your production weight and size range?
We can produce castings ranging from approximately 10 grams up to 80 kilograms, with various shapes and wall thicknesses down to 2.0mm.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.sjnb1lwgnfop)
Q5: Do you provide machining and surface finishing?
Yes. We offer Conventional / CNC machining, vibratory finishing, shot blasting, and custom jigs & fixtures for secondary operations. Heat treatment and other finishing processes are available through our qualified partners.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.htpydyro0ndn)
Q6: Do you manufacture tooling in-house?
Yes. We design and fabricate aluminum and steel molds in-house to ensure full control over quality, precision, and lead time.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.ox2djadrk3j8)
Q7: What is your typical lead time?
  * Tooling & sampling: 25 ~ 45 working days.
  * Production orders: 45 ~ 60 working days depending on volume and process.  
Rush orders may be accommodated upon request.  
  



### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.mk3xv6a2lny0)
Q8: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
We offer flexible MOQs to support new product development. Small batches starting from 50 pieces are acceptable, depending on part size and complexity.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.ayrdmrgo8zj)
Q9: What quality control processes do you follow?
All parts are thoroughly inspected using:
  * Spectrometer for material composition
  * CMM and gauges for dimensional accuracy after machining.
  * Visual and surface inspection for defects  
Inspection reports and material certificates are provided upon request.  
  



### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.6bx44x73dk4v)
Q10: Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We regularly ship parts to Singapore, Indonesia, Japan, and other global markets via air or sea freight. We support EXW, FOB, and DDP shipping terms.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.44m1o136913s)
Q11: Do you sign NDAs or handle confidential projects?
Absolutely. We welcome NDA agreements and treat all client data, drawings, and communications with strict confidentiality.
  

### 
[](https://www.cordialcastings.com.my/our-capabilities/frequently-asked-questions-faq#h.z5eadg6gfdij)
Q12: What are your payment terms?
  * Tooling fees are typically 100% prepaid
  * Production terms are flexible and can be discussed case by case

### Quality Assurance
At Cordial Resources Enterprise, quality is not an afterthought — it's built into every stage of our casting and production process. From raw material verification to final inspection, we adhere to strict internal standards and customer specifications to ensure every part meets or exceeds expectations.
### ? Quality Control Workflow
  * **Pre-pour Spectrometer Analysis:** Each melt is tested with a spectrometer before pouring to ensure chemical composition meets required alloy specifications.
  * **In-Process Inspection:** Visual, dimensional, and sample testing performed during wax assembly, shell building, and after dewaxing.
  * **Post-Casting Inspection:** Surface integrity check, dimensional validation, and hardness test after casting and post-processing.
  * **Final Quality Gate:** 100% inspection before packing to ensure parts meet customer drawing, tolerance, and cosmetic standards.


### ? Inspection & Testing Equipment
  * Pre-pour Spectrometer (chemical composition verification)
  * Digital Vernier Calipers & Micrometers
  * Height Gauges
  * Hardness Testers (Rockwell, Brinell)
  * Surface Roughness Tester
  * Pressure Test Setup (Hydrostatic / Air Leak)
  * Visual Inspection & Go/No-Go Gauges
  * Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) – via certified partners
  * Material Certificates & Test Reports – provided upon request


### ? Quality Documentation
We support full traceability and documentation as part of our commitment to quality. Depending on your project needs, we can provide:
  * Material Test Certificates (MTC)
  * Dimension Reports
  * Inspection Checklists
  * Hardness / Surface Finish Reports
  * Non-Destructive Test (NDT) Results
  * FAIR / PPAP (if applicable)


### ? Trusted for Critical Applications
Our customers trust us to supply parts for industries where failure is not an option — including palm oil processing, marine, heavy equipment, and precision engineering. We continuously improve through team training, supplier audits, and feedback review to uphold consistent standards.
